faqs.a:
This article is intended to promote the orderly and planned provisions of access to
               the street system of the city, through the establishment of access control standards.
               After March 27, 1979, these standards shall apply to all new access points constructed,
               all new property development and any redevelopment which would change the amount and
               type of traffic generated by the development.
(Code 1981, § 30-136; Ord. No. 1544, § 1, 3-19-1979)
